title: One set of controls: China
kaylee: On the Great Wall, the pink arrow that slides her along to Hou Hou is now the same round pink button as every other way on: a white ring and the drawn play, breathing while Hou Hou waits. It stays in the same place and still turns round when she has to walk back.
